name: demo-playwright-rust-for-nhs-wales
summary: A beginner-friendly Playwright + Rust demo (using the playwright-rs crate) that drives a real browser against the real, live NHS Wales website.
description: This demo drives a real Chromium browser to https://www.nhs.wales/ using Playwright (via the playwright-rs crate) and Rust, and runs three real assertion-based checks: the home page title, the About Us page title and headline, and the search results page. It is meant as a friendly, top-to-bottom walkthrough for learning Playwright browser automation against a live production site.
